label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75 a.2…: The designated human intellectual principle is not a…
locator: I q.75 a.2 co.: Impossibile est igitur quod principium intellectuale sit corpus
interpretation: The first subconclusion denies that the intellectual principle is a body. The later non-organic operation and subsistence steps are separate. The limited conclusion must not be substituted for the highest immateriality used of God in q.14 or for a refutation of all physicalism.
